name: CN_COMP_PLAN_ASSESS_ALL
description: The CN_COMP_PLAN_ASSESS_ALL table stores information about the sales objectives for the plan.

columns.name: COMP_PLAN_ASSESS_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the plan sales objectives record.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: COMP_PLAN_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the plan record.

columns.name: ASSESS_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the objectives assessment template record.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the objectives assessment period starts.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the objectives assessment period ends.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: The on which the objectives assessment is due.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the credit category record.

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_DESIGNEE
columns.description: The lookup code that represents the ownership designation for the assessment, such as the participant and manager, manager, or a specific user.

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_TYPE
columns.description: The code that represents the assessment type, such as participant objectives or key sales objectives.

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the key sales objectives assessment owner.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
